title: Facebook Has a New Marketplace App and Verification Checks for Everyone - CNET
summary: Many of us only open Meta’s original social media app to browse listings on Facebook Marketplace. Now, sellers are getting a new standalone app to help manage their listings, Meta announced on Friday.
